orgAccountPrompt: Use your organisational account to continue.
taglineDesc: Manage company workspaces, projects, teams and delivery from one focused operating view.
devOnlyPrompt: Development only: sign in with a seeded account (mints a server-side BFF session).

errors.ssoInit: Could not initiate sign-in. Please try again.
errors.devLoginFailed: Login failed. Check the email is a seeded account and the API is running.
errors.devApiUnreachable: Could not reach the API. Is it running on :3000?

acceptInvitation.pendingDescription: Confirming the invitation and setting up your access.
acceptInvitation.joinedToast: Invitation accepted — welcome to Mini Rova.
acceptInvitation.signOutAndRetry: Sign out and use another account

missingToken.title: This invitation link is incomplete
missingToken.description: The link carries no invitation token. Open the link in your invitation email again, and copy the whole address including everything after the question mark.

notFound.title: We could not find this invitation
notFound.description: The link does not match any invitation. Ask your Workspace Admin to send you a new one.

alreadyUsed.title: This invitation has already been used
alreadyUsed.description: It was accepted or cancelled earlier, so it cannot be used again. If you have already joined, continue to Mini Rova.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: Invitations are only valid for a limited time. Ask your Workspace Admin to send you a new one.

emailMismatch.title: You are signed in with the wrong account
emailMismatch.description: This invitation was sent to a different email address, and only that person can accept it. Sign out, then open the invitation link again and sign in with the invited address.

roleIsProjectTier.title: This invitation cannot be accepted
roleIsProjectTier.description: It was created with a role that cannot be granted at invitation. Nothing is wrong on your side — ask your Workspace Admin to send you a new invitation.

unknown.title: We could not complete this just now
unknown.description: Something went wrong and nothing has changed. Try again in a moment.
